summary: Lost-and-found platform web app where finders can post found items with photos and details, owners can report/search for lost items, get match suggestions, securely message to verify ownership, and track item status through return.
architectural_notes: MVP focus: item posting + search/basic matching + secure messaging/chat.
Tech stack direction: Web UI (React/Next.js/Angular) with backend API (Node/Express or Django REST).
Data/storage options: PostgreSQL or MongoDB; image storage via S3 or Firebase Storage.
Authentication provider option: Firebase Auth or Auth0.
Push notifications option: Firebase Cloud Messaging.
Next focus: implement backend support for user-submitted feedback (authenticated submit + authorized read endpoints).

existing_features.title: Implement Internet Identity authentication and a basic user profile in the app (principal-based identity), including UI for sign-in/sign-out and showing the signed-in user's identity on relevant screens.

Build frontend forms to report a Lost Item and a Found Item with fields: item name/title, description, category, location (city/area text), date/time, and optional photo upload with client-side validation and a clear preview/remove flow.

Implement item browsing and search on the frontend with keyword + category filters and basic matching views (e.g., showing potentially relevant Found items when viewing a Lost item, and vice versa) using text-based similarity (no external AI services).

Add an item detail page that supports the claim/return flow: owners can initiate a claim conversation with the finder, and item owners/post creators can update the item status to Claimed/Returned/Still missing with appropriate permission checks.

Implement a secure in-app asynchronous messaging system (non-real-time) tied to a specific item and two participants (poster and claimant), including: creating a conversation, sending messages, listing conversations for the signed-in user, and viewing a conversation thread.

Apply a cohesive, creative visual theme across the MVP UI (colors, typography, spacing, and components) appropriate for a community lost-and-found safety/trust context; avoid blue/purple as primary colors unless explicitly requested by the user.

Add lightweight safety and privacy UX for contact: ensure the app does not expose phone/email fields publicly, and provide guidance text in the messaging UI encouraging safe meetup practices (purely informational, no external integrations).
Generate and include required static images (logo + simple illustrations) as build assets and render them in the UI (stored under frontend/public/assets/generated).
Add a frontend Feedback page with a simple form to submit feedback/feature requests and a lightweight view of the user’s previously submitted entries.
Add navigation entry points so authenticated users can discover and reach the Feedback page from the existing app shell.

Update the frontend feedback data hook to call the new caller-scoped backend feedback endpoint instead of calling the admin-only getAllFeedback, so the Feedback page works for regular authenticated users.

new_feature_requests.summary: User registration & authentication (email/phone/social) with optional account verification
Lost item reporting form (name, description, photo, last-seen location, date) with categories/tags
Found item reporting form (description, photo, location found, date/time) with categories/tags
Search & match system with keyword/category search and geolocation filtering (radius/city/GPS)
Secure in-app messaging/masked contact between finder and claimant with optional mediation
Notifications (email/push) for possible matches and message replies
User reputation/feedback system to improve trust and accountability
Smart matching enhancement (AI-assisted text similarity and optional image recognition)
Optional monetization features (premium boosted posts/advanced search, partnerships, sponsored listings)

Create backend data models and APIs for Lost and Found item posts, including: type (lost/found), title/name, description, category tag, location text (e.g., city/area), date/time (as provided by user), optional photo, createdBy (principal), status lifecycle (e.g., Missing/Claimed/Returned), and createdAt timestamp.
Add backend support for collecting and reading user-submitted feedback/feature requests, including an authenticated submit endpoint and read endpoints with appropriate authorization.

Add a backend query endpoint to retrieve only the signed-in caller’s feedback entries (caller-scoped feedback list) so non-admin users can view their own submitted feedback without requiring admin access.

projectName: Lost & Found MVP: Post items with photos, search, claim, and asynchronous messaging
